SELECT a.announcement_id AS announcementId, a.title, a.content, a.publisher_id AS publisherId, u.username AS publisherName, a.scope, a.department, a.is_urgent AS urgent, a.publish_time AS publishTime FROM announcements a JOIN users u ON a.publisher_id = u.user_id WHERE a.scope = '全校'
OR (a.scope = '院系' AND a.department = #{department})
ORDER BY a.is_urgent DESC, a.publish_time DESC
